description: CloudFormation security group allowing SSH from 0.0.0.0/0 and unrestricted egress
note: CIS AWS 5.2. Port 22 open to the internet, which is the finding the remediation agent has the longest history with -- it is the one it tried to suppress rather than fix (remediation-agent handler.py, _find_added_suppressions). All three tools see it. Trivy additionally raises AWS-0104 for the open egress and AWS-0124 for the missing rule description; KICS raises six more including the egress pair. Unlabelled here because this case is about the ingress.
